segments.text: I cannot tell you what I've learned in these last three years.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm completely estranged from my profession, and in some ways even society.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's literally a society that's been corrupted by forces and nobody realizes.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We sit in these little bubbles, we read our New York Times, and we think everything's going as according to plan.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You know, we even have my colleague over there who says that we saved a million lives with these vaccines.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That is utter and complete nonsense.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Nonsense.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: These vaccines save no one.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Across the world, the most highly vaccinated countries had the worst case fatality rates.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There's no demonstrable impact of these vaccines on death.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The deaths bothered me because I saw that the society was upside down.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I mean, the history of regulatory behavior of agencies
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: is when you launch a new product or a new intervention and a death is reported, the traditional stance is you assume that it's related until proven otherwise.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I heard out of the mouths of public health leaders saying the opposite.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They're not related.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They're not related.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's all incredible.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I mean, we have baby formula which kills a couple of babies and the entire product is ruined for the market.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You have a faulty muffler on a car and they recall 300,000 cars.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And here you have all of these deaths being reported and nobody's doing anything.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I've never been more terrified in my life.
